subject: [Invite] AI/ML Execs Dinner in NYC - Jan 28
text:
Hi [NAME],

On behalf of my co-founders, [SENDER] and [SENDER], I'd love to invite you to an
exclusive, off-the-record dinner for senior AI leaders on Wednesday,
January 28th, at 6:30PM.

We are hosting a small group of 20 peers - specifically Chief AI Officers
and Heads of ML building their own models - for a candid discussion held
strictly under the Chatham House Rule. The evening will take place in the
private dining room of the Michelin-starred Le Pavillon, and we'll provide
a $50 Uber credit for your travel to and from the venue.

In case Encord is new to you: we're a Series B ($50M) company based in SF,
supporting 200+ teams working on multimodal AI, including Boston Dynamics,
Thinking Machines Lab, and Synthesia.

With only a few seats remaining for this curated group, I'd love to have
you join us for the conversation. Can I pencil you in?

subject: [NAME] - Fraud Patterns
text:
Hi [NAME],

When speaking with fraud prevention leaders, we often hear that in-house
data management tools are limited primarily to annotation.

Encord is a YC-backed startup helping many leading IDV teams build AI
models faster and more easily.

By combining advanced data curation with embedding and cluster-based
search, we help fraud teams achieve higher model accuracy and improved
visibility into emerging fraud patterns.

I'd love to explore how we could solve similar challenges for [COMPANY] -
would you be open to learning more?

subject: Virtual Coffee - road/ driver safety
text:
Hi [NAME],

I met Mengliao Wang at the Ray Summit - it sounds like building
vision-based model for AI Dashcam is a key focus for your team, much like
our customer Motive. So I wanted to reach out for a virtual coffee.

For context - Motive leverages Encord to standardize video data operation
at scale. We help unifying auto-annotation and manual adjustment and QA in
one platform, so program managers can focus on assessing labelling
accuracy, workforce productivity and dataset representativeness in close
collaboration with technical stakeholders.

Keen to hear where you see operational efficiency gain. Would you be open
to a virtual coffee afternoon times tomorrow?

subject: Procore - catch up
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope your [YEAR] is off to a good start! I've been following your work
scaling Procore's AI platform and Construction Cloud - really impressive.

I'm speaking with heads of data/AI building enterprise AI platforms in
construction, where data is inherently multimodal - site images, video,
drawings/PDFs, and sensor/time series data. At Encord, we work with teams
in construction and robotics to streamline multimodal workflows (curation,
annotation, evaluation). I'd love to get your perspective on how you
approach data quality, feedback loops, and governance at scale.

Would you have 20 minutes next week for a quick virtual coffee to compare
notes? I'm flexible Tue to Thu mornings PT but happy to work around your
schedule.
